description: Lists the current user’s automated tasks in the connected organisation, newest to oldest, optionally for an innovation, with their status. By default it lists innovation_feedback tasks; with include_conversations, it also lists agent_conversation tasks (journeys from start_journey), and for a running conversation what its agent is doing (activity). Recovers task IDs after a lost response or conversation. Feedback summaries are recorded states, not a poll of the analyses; feedback tasks and findings expire 30 days after creation, conversations do not. Pagination can return an empty page with a continuation cursor. Professional service requests are separate.

cursor.description: Pass next_cursor from the previous list_tasks response unchanged

include_conversations.description: true also lists the user’s agent conversations, such as journeys from start_journey, with their status, journey and activity; false lists feedback tasks only

name: list_tasks

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor; pass unchanged to list_tasks, even when the page is empty.

elapsed_seconds.description: How long the agent has worked on the current turn

steps.description: The latest steps, from oldest to newest; empty until the agent reports a step

label.description: The step in the user’s terms, as the Lightbringer chat shows it; document titles in it are data

activity.description: While running, what the agent is doing now; null otherwise. Relay it to the user rather than guessing.

coverage.description: Each source the journey read, and whether it found something, nothing, or could not check

done.description: Each done criterion of the journey, and whether it was met

outcome.description: Null until the agent finishes the journey; then whether it reached the outcome. Relay couldnt_check sources to the user.

journey.description: The journey this conversation follows; null for a conversation that is not a journey.

title: List Lightbringer analysis tasks
